value.rationale: Positional resets carry a cost while persistent target gating introduces serial memory across resets. The strict two-geometric mixture, decreasing conditional completion hazard, and variance excess versus a same-mean geometric process are full-model, all-parameter predictions that separate genuine gate memory from the conventional renewal-reset model; they quantify a motivated rare-intervention risk not measured by the previously known mean search time.
